prompt.prompt_text:
Objective
You are executing roadmap step M1-CON-2 (Consistency: Lint/static analysis green with pinned tooling).

Current state:
- The latest rubric report at hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json is FAIL.
- CON-2 (golangci-lint) FAIL, SEC-1 (gosec-only lint run) FAIL, and SEC-2 (govulncheck) FAIL.
- The immediate cause in CON-2/SEC-1/SEC-2 logs is a Go typecheck error in hgm-infra/verifiers: multiple Go files in the same folder are 'package main' and both declare main() and collectGoFiles(), causing symbol redeclaration errors. Tools that analyze ./... then fail to load packages, producing false negatives.

Goal for this step:
Make the verifier helper programs structurally valid Go packages so static analysis tools can load the repo.

Scope (allowed changes)
- You MAY modify files under:
  - hgm-infra/verifiers/**
  - hgm-infra/evidence/** (new evidence, progress notes)
  - hgm-infra/planning/** only if you need to record the baseline/result or add a TODO pointer
- You MUST NOT modify production/app code under pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/**, examples/** in this step.
- You MUST NOT weaken lint/security policy (no new blanket excludes, no disabling linters, no widening exclusions).
- You MUST NOT write outside hgm-infra/.

Why this is the next best step
Fixing verifier code structure is the smallest, highest-leverage change: it removes the current false failures and restores trustworthy lint/security gates without touching application code.

Inputs to inspect (read-only)
- hgm-infra/evidence/CON-2-output.log
- hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-1-output.log
- hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-2-output.log
- hgm-infra/verifiers/mai3-dupcheck.go
- hgm-infra/verifiers/com6-logging-standards-check.go
- hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh

Work to perform
1) Confirm the failure mode
   - Read CON-2/SEC-1/SEC-2 logs and confirm they fail due to redeclared identifiers in hgm-infra/verifiers (duplicate main() / collectGoFiles()).

2) Restructure verifier Go programs so they do not share a package
   - Create subdirectories so each verifier tool is its own package main, for example:
     - hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/mai3-dupcheck/main.go
     - hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check/main.go
   - Move the existing code from:
     - hgm-infra/verifiers/mai3-dupcheck.go -> hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/mai3-dupcheck/main.go
     - hgm-infra/verifiers/com6-logging-standards-check.go -> hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check/main.go
   - After moving, ensure there are no remaining .go files directly under hgm-infra/verifiers/ that will be combined into a single Go package by tooling.
   - Keep program behavior identical; do not change COM-6 or MAI-3 policy logic in this step (structural changes only).

3) Update the deterministic verifier entrypoint
   - In hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh, update the go run commands to point at the new directories (not the old single-file paths).
   - Use a directory invocation form such as:
     - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check
     - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/mai3-dupcheck
   - Do not change rubric IDs, thresholds, or command semantics beyond minimal path changes.

4) Formatting & tool sanity checks
   - gofmt the moved files.
   - Sanity-check each tool runs:
     - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/mai3-dupcheck
     - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check

5) Re-run the rubric verifier and capture updated evidence
   - Run:
     - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm that CON-2 / SEC-1 / SEC-2 no longer fail due to Go package load/typecheck errors originating from hgm-infra/verifiers.
   - Note: these checks may still FAIL for real reasons (repo lint issues, govulncheck not installed, etc.). That is acceptable for this step; the key requirement is removing the verifier-structure-induced false failures.

6) Record progress (hgm-infra only)
   - Create a new progress note under hgm-infra/evidence/ named:
     - hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M1-CON-2-<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>.md
   - Include:
     - What was broken (duplicate main/collectGoFiles in one directory)
     - What you changed (moved to cmd/* packages; updated hgm-verify-rubric.sh)
     - Commands run
     - Pointers to evidence logs and refreshed hgm-rubric-report.json

Acceptance criteria
- golangci-lint / gosec / govulncheck no longer fail due to typecheck errors in hgm-infra/verifiers caused by duplicate mains in a single package.
- bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh runs to completion and produces a refreshed hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json.
- A progress note is recorded under hgm-infra/evidence/.

Guardrails (must-follow)
- Do not modify application code outside hgm-infra/.
- Do not change lint/security policy (no new excludes, no disabling linters, no threshold reductions).
- Do not write outside hgm-infra/.
prompt.step_description: Fix golangci-lint/gosec/govulncheck failures caused by hgm-infra/verifiers containing multiple Go 'main' programs in a single package; split verifier tools into separate cmd subdirectories and update the verifier entrypoint; rerun verifier and capture updated evidence.
